title: SCS Checkpoint Record
description: Schema for a checkpoint record: a small, normative shape recording which bundle version governed a given point in a workflow's execution (any-ai-actor-model.md, RFC-0001/ISS-006). Not an SCD - generated at runtime, not authored, carries no tier/content-schema/relationships. Any orchestrator can emit one; any tool can read one.

bundle.description: The exact bundle id + version that was in effect at this checkpoint.

concept.description: Optional: which concept's context this checkpoint reflects.

agent.description: The role (or equivalent actor identity) this checkpoint applies to (any-ai-actor-model.md §2.3). Conventionally a role: id, but not restricted to the meta-tier role vocabulary.

intent.description: The task/step being performed - the same value used to select this context in the first place (any-ai-actor-model.md §2.3).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this checkpoint was recorded.

workflow_ref.description: Opaque, orchestrator-defined reference back to whatever the runtime calls 'the workflow'. SCS does not interpret this value - it exists purely so a checkpoint record can be traced back to its execution context without SCS needing a model of what a workflow is.
